import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_41/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_41/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
source2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_41/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
source3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_41/training_3.csv", index_col=0)

# All sources have schema ['x', 'y', 'label'] but label is categorical string, target label is integer
# Map label values to integer 1 as per intermediate_step1.csv example (label=1 for all rows)
# Also reorder columns to ['y', 'x', 'label'] and convert types accordingly

def process_source(df):
    # Convert label to integer 1 for all rows (based on intermediate_step1.csv showing label=1)
    df = df.copy()
    df['label'] = 1
    # Reorder columns to ['y', 'x', 'label']
    df = df[['y', 'x', 'label']]
    # Convert types: y to float, x to int, label to int
    df['y'] = df['y'].astype(float)
    df['x'] = df['x'].astype(int)
    df['label'] = df['label'].astype(int)
    return df

source0_proc = process_source(source0)
source1_proc = process_source(source1)
source2_proc = process_source(source2)
source3_proc = process_source(source3)

# UNION all processed sources
target_df = pd.concat([source0_proc, source1_proc, source2_proc, source3_proc], ignore_index=True)

# Write the final target table to the specified path
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_41/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
